verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents a first-party bulk update for employee data, and auto payroll runs across salaried employees as a batch. Beyond that single thin mention, there is no evidence of bulk operations across other item types or of programmatic batch endpoints in the Workforce API. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond employee records, documented API or agent-driven batch operations, detail on bulk-edit depth and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
